question: at what angular and axial resolution is a per-bin soft-tissue map supported by the data

cross_phase_comparison.reason: the delta map needs rib-anchored correspondence from Gate 1B; W2 only measures within-phase spatial stability

measurand.name: soft_tissue_mm
measurand.definition: fat_mm + muscle_mm + other_mm along the lung-to-skin path
measurand.reason: D-044 merged fat and muscle into one tissue; separate components stay diagnostic

frame.radial_origin: per-slice centroid of the filled body mask
frame.axial_coordinate: z of the skin endpoint, normalised to the baseline lung extent
frame.reason: binning by the dominant axis of the lung-to-skin vector is not an anatomical frame and produced bins with sigma up to 36.94 mm; see D-045

per_bin_noise.primary: bootstrap standard error of the per-bin median, 400 resamples, seed 20260731
per_bin_noise.statistic: p95 across occupied bins of the bootstrap standard error
per_bin_noise.confirmation: actual per-bin median shift under the five W1 perturbation families, run only at the selected configuration
per_bin_noise.reason: the W1 spatial spread was already bounded by median sampling error, so the bootstrap is the primary estimator and the perturbation run is the check that nothing systematic hides under it

occupancy.reason: a bin below the minimum cannot support a median and is reported as unresolved rather than plotted

selection_rule.selected: the finest map resolution, at the coarsest sampling density that supports it, whose p95 per-bin noise is <= feasible_max_mm AND whose occupied fraction is >= min_occupied_fraction, in both phases
selection_rule.no_selection: if no configuration qualifies, report the best marginal one and select nothing
selection_rule.frozen: resolutions, densities, thresholds and this rule are fixed before computing; no configuration may be added after seeing the numbers

out_of_scope: any comparison between inspiration and expiration
any delta map, which stays blocked until Gate 1B
changing the Gate 2 validity domain, which is a separate frozen change
reporting separate fat and muscle as a result
